title: Independent Fan-out
summary: One published event is copied to every interested subscriber independently.
recognition_signals: every subscriber must receive the same event
subscribers are independent of one another
a slow subscriber must not consume another subscriber's copy
core_rules: Each subscriber receives its own delivery of a published event.
structural_steps: the topic routes a copy to each subscriber

common_confusions.distinction: A queue distributes each message to one competing consumer. Pub/sub delivers its own copy to every subscriber.
